questions.prompt: Which wall was built by the Romans in Scotland, north of Hadrian's?
questions.fact: It was built of turf rather than stone and abandoned within a generation.

questions.prompt: What is the term for two species that benefit each other?
questions.fact: Roughly ninety percent of land plants have such a relationship with fungi around their roots.

questions.prompt: Which country has won the most Winter Olympic medals overall?
questions.fact: It has a population under six million, which makes its medal-per-person rate extraordinary.

questions.prompt: Which musician wrote the song Imagine?
questions.fact: He later said the credit should have included Yoko Ono, whose book supplied several of the lines.

questions.prompt: Which country contains the Dead Sea's western shore?
questions.fact: The eastern shore is Jordanian, and both countries draw so much water upstream that the sea is splitting in two.

questions.prompt: Which 1516 work by Thomas More describes an imaginary island society?
questions.fact: The name means no place in Greek, which suggests its author was not entirely serious about the proposal.

questions.prompt: Which company produces the Unreal game engine?
questions.fact: It is now used widely outside gaming, including for film backgrounds and architectural visualisation.
